Because of this, I read many books in the library. Then I decided to become a teacher. My grandmother was very kind and she taught me to respect other people. When I was an elementary school student, I lived in Hiroshima with my grandmother. She always told me stories about the war, so I became interested in history. Because of this, I read many books in the library, and I later decided to become a teacher. My grandmother was very kind, and she taught me to respect other people. She is the most important person in my life, which is why I want to write about her in this paragraph. Her stories taught me that peace is not natural; it is something we must protect.

I started playing the piano when I was five years old. At first I did not like practice because it was boring and my teacher was strict. However, my mother said that if I quit, then I will regret it in the future. So I continued. In junior high school I joined a band and I played keyboard. It was so fun. Therefore, now I think music is a part of my identity. I want to teach music to children, for they can express their feelings without words. Otherwise, some children keep their feelings inside.

Smartphones have changed the way students study. First, students can search information quickly. For example, they can check a word in a dictionary app in a few seconds. Second, they can study with videos. However, smartphones also have a problem. Many students use social media during studying, so they cannot concentrate. As a result, their scores become lower. In this respect, smartphones are a double-edged sword. Consequently, teachers should teach students how to use them in a good way. To this end, schools can make clear rules.

Part-time jobs are common among Japanese university students. They give students money and experience. Because many students live alone, they need money for rent and food. Working also teaches them responsibility and manners. On the other hand, a part-time job takes a lot of time. If a student works too much, then he or she has no time to study. Under the circumstances, students should choose a job carefully. Aside from this, they should talk with their family. Thus, a balance between work and study is the key.

I enjoyed your story very much. The main character is interesting because she has a secret. However, the ending was a little sudden. I think you should add one more scene before the ending, so that readers can understand why she leaves the village. Also, some sentences are very long. For this reason, it is difficult to follow the action. In that case, you can divide them into two sentences. Your descriptions of the forest are beautiful, so please keep them.

Thank you for revising your story. The new scene makes the ending more natural, so the story is easier to understand. I like that the main character now explains her secret to her brother. Then the reader feels sad with her. One small point is the dialogue. Some characters speak in the same way, therefore it is hard to know who is speaking. With this in mind, you could give each character a special way of talking. Overall, your second draft is much stronger than the first.

In the picture, two scientists are working in a laboratory. The older man is looking at a test tube and the younger man is writing something. I think they are trying to make a new medicine because many people are sick in their town. The older man is worried, for the experiment failed many times. Hence they are tired. But the younger man has a new idea. Then they try again at night. Finally the medicine works and they become famous. However, the older man only wants to help people, not to be famous.

The picture shows a scientist and his assistant. They look very serious. Maybe the assistant made a mistake in the experiment and the scientist is angry. The assistant feels nervous, so he is not looking at the scientist's face. On account of this mistake, they must start the experiment from the beginning. It follows that they will lose a lot of time and money. In the end, the scientist forgives him because everyone makes mistakes. They become a good team and they discover an useful chemical.
